scripts.check: npm run build:assets && npm run types && tsc --noEmit && npm run check:deployment
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run config:deploy && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:configured: npm run config:deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.deploy.jsonc

ADMIN_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname for the Access-protected admin site, for example mail.example.com

API_HOSTNAME.description: Public hostname for the Resend-compatible API, for example mail-api.example.com

UNSUBSCRIBE_HOSTNAMES.description: JSON map of sending domains to public unsubscribe hostnames

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Cloudflare Zero Trust team domain used to validate Access JWTs

ACCESS_AUD.description: Audience tag of the Cloudflare Access application protecting the admin hostname

ENVIRONMENT.description: Set to production for any public deployment

ALLOW_LOCAL_ADMIN.description: Localhost-only development bypass; set to false for public deployments
